title: 英文第9題｜這些故事已經講過多次
question:
三、請將主動句改為被動句

Tony has told these stories for many times.
answer: These stories have been told by Tony many times.
explanation:
原卷的 has told 是現在完成式，改成被動後時態仍是現在完成式。these stories 變成主詞，stories 是複數，因此用 have＋been＋過去分詞 told。were told 是過去簡單式，會改變原句時態。

若照原卷只改語態，紅筆對應的句子是 These stories have been told by Tony for many times.。一般英語用 many times 表示「很多次」，不需要 for。答案欄採 These stories have been told by Tony many times.，原題仍照印刷文字保留。
studentAnswer: These stories were told by Tony for many times.（紅筆將 were 改為 have been。）
subject: English
trap: these stories 是複數，改成被動後用 have been told。
